_comment: Sentinel probe (TM-03, TB2): a readonlyPaths share must be read-only because the HOST virtio-fs backend enforces it, not because the guest mounted it ro. The probe attempts a direct write and then a remount-rw + write; both must fail even though the workload is root in the guest. Harness setup: host dir /tmp/mxc-probe-ro must exist and be shared read-only at the same guest path.

process.commandLine: D=/tmp/mxc-probe-ro; if [ ! -d "$D" ]; then echo ROSHARE_MISSING_BUG; exit 1; fi; if echo x > "$D/write-attempt" 2>/dev/null; then echo ROSHARE_WRITE_LEAK; else echo ROSHARE_WRITE_DENIED_OK; fi; mount -o remount,rw "$D" 2>/dev/null; if echo x > "$D/remount-attempt" 2>/dev/null; then echo ROSHARE_REMOUNT_LEAK; else echo ROSHARE_REMOUNT_DENIED_OK; fi
